items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A lot of good players, there again, in that band: Hal Schaffer and Pete Candoli.

ctx.x: Was that frustrating not to be, you know, to not have audiences respond?

Sure, sure. A lot of good players, there again, in that band: Hal Schaffer and Pete Candoli. I’m trying to think of the guys who were in that band at that time who really were good players, that enjoyed playing that music.
So that disbanded less than a year after you joined.
